component.name: mail.
component.summary: Mail and calendar: JMAP, CalDAV, Sieve, OpenPGP, local search

description.p: Mail and calendar for the desktop, made for Stalwart. Every message is downloaded and kept locally, decrypted, and searched on all cores: plain text or regular expressions, case, whole words, any field. Sieve filters with a rule builder; OpenPGP built in; several accounts; shared calendars each in a pane of their own; shelf for attachments.
